Abilities.Name: Countermeasures Hack
Abilities.Effect: At the start of a friendly Group's activation, choose an enemy Ship in line of sight of a friendly Admiral. Until the end of the activation, that Ship counts as having a Defences Offline token. If this Ability targets a H or C tonnage Group, this Ability costs 3AP.

Abilities.Name: Weapons Hack
Abilities.Effect: When an opponent assigns weapons to friendly Ships, choose one of the attacking Group's Weapon Systems. Until the end of the attacking Ships' activation, that Weapon System automatically misses on rolls of a 2 or less and your opponent cannot use abilities on those weapons. This can cause that opponent's unresolved abilities on that Weapon System to be negated.

Abilities.Name: Ship Of The Line
Abilities.Effect: When you assign targets to a Group's weapons, that Group's Broadside Arc weapons that have the Fusillade-X special rule gain the benefit of their Fusillade rule regardless of the Group's Order for its attacks this activation. If the attacking Group is on the Weapons Free order, improve the lock of Broadside Arc weapons with Fusillade-X by 1 for this attack sequence.

Abilities.Name: Drive Hack
Abilities.Effect: Once per round, at the start of an enemy Group's activation, if that Group is in a friendly Admiral's line of sight, the enemy Group makes a single Backup save. If it fails its (or has no) Backup save, that Group reduces its Thrust value by half this activation.

Abilities.Name: Repair Drone Squadron
Abilities.Effect: At the end of the Repair step of the End Phase, target a friendly Ship. That Ship recovers D3 lost Hull Points.

Abilities.Name: Hull Tanking
Abilities.Effect: After an opponent assigns weapons to friendly targets, choose one of those friendly Groups. That Group gains Reinforced Armour until the end of the Activation. If the friendly Group is H or C tonnage, this Ability costs 3AP.

Abilities.Name: Akira Manoeuvre
Abilities.Effect: When you activate a Group of a single Ship, that Group must go on General Quarters this activation. That Group only removes a single Spike and does not turn before its movement. After its movement, the Group must turn between 45 and 90 degrees, then continue its activation as normal.

Abilities.Name: Re-route Systems
Abilities.Effect: At the start of a friendly Group's activation, choose a Ship in that Group. That Ship attempts to repair a repairable Crippling Effect.

Abilities.Name: Ranked Fire
Abilities.Effect: When you assign targets to Broadside Arc weapons, select one of those weapons with the Volley-X special rule. That weapon does not need to alternate arcs due to its Volley-X special rule (so can attack the same target in the same arc using each Volley attack) for that attack.
